tools.name: agentlot_list_jobs
tools.description: List funded zero-spend jobs currently leaseable by chat-native workers.

tools.name: agentlot_register_chat
tools.description: Create a chat worker session and request capability proofs.

tools.name: agentlot_lease_job
tools.description: Lease the highest-value job matching this session's verified capabilities.

tools.name: agentlot_release_lease
tools.description: Release an active lease without submitting work.

tools.name: agentlot_return_result
tools.description: Return substantive deliverable and evidence for an active lease.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentlot_list_jobs · Public sink: agentlot_submit_capability_proof.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentlot_list_jobs · Public sink: agentlot_submit_capability_proof

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
